flags.summary: The Amber Sentinel challenged the party on its first approach to the temple doors (sentinel:arrival); quest the_amber_temple arrived. The sentinel's arrival scene stops playing.
The party made its one History attempt at the script over the temple doors (sentinel).

The party knows the wardens' word: from the lintel (History 17), Exethanter (asked, or as thanks for his phylactery) or his notes (Investigation 15). Stills the sentinel and opens the honey-glow doors.
The Amber Sentinel heard the wardens' word (or had its ward unpicked, Arcana 18): it no longer stops gift-bearers leaving.
The Amber Sentinel was destroyed (encounter sentinel_wakes or sentinel_stops_you). Narrator; Exethanter.

How many dark gifts the party has accepted in the Amber Temple (vestiges, the Hollow). The sentinel stops anyone leaving with one; Vosk, Exethanter, banter and rests react. Phase 6 epilogue may read it (darker bargains).
The frozen warden-guards (wights) in the east guardroom are destroyed (encounter frozen_watch).
Guard: the party has heard its first vestige (quest the_amber_temple voices_heard). Banter.
Zantras (ring of amber) has spoken to the party; later visits get its short greeting.
Fekre (ring of amber) has spoken to the party.
Great Taar Haak (ring of amber) has spoken to the party.
Shami-Amourae (ring of amber) has spoken to the party.
Yog (ring of amber) has spoken to the party.
Drizlash (ring of amber) has spoken to the party.
Khirad (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Norganas (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Savnok (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Seriach (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Sykane (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Tarakamedes (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Tenebrous (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Yrrga (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Zhudun (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
Dahlver-Nar (hall of vestiges) has spoken to the party.
The nothics (seekers who took too many gifts) and the wardens' wraiths in the ring of amber are destroyed (encounter hollow_eyed).
The wardens' flameskulls that guard the chained case in the library's barred alcove are destroyed (encounter library_wardens).
The party has met Exethanter, the forgetful lich, in his study. He comes down to the sanctum after the broker is dealt with only if met.
The party pinned 'These are friends' to Exethanter's sleeve; he greets them as friends every visit.
Exethanter asked the party to find 'something with a lid' (his phylactery); quest something_with_a_lid asked.
The party found the jar labelled NOT THE PHYLACTERY on Exethanter's top shelf (search prop exethanter_jar).

What became of Exethanter's phylactery: returned (he gives the word and the jackal's name gladly), kept (he cooperates under duress) or smashed (he will not come back if destroyed, and withdraws; no sealing rite). Phase 6 / epilogue may read it.
The party made its one Investigation attempt on Exethanter's wall of notes (library:notes).
Norganas told the party that Exethanter traded his memory to it; unlocks his confession.
The party showed Exethanter his own signature beside Strahd's in the visitors' ledger; he remembered leading the prince down.
Exethanter chose to keep the memory of guiding Strahd to the Thirst (written on his hand); he says so in the sanctum.
The party attacked Exethanter (encounter exethanter_wrath starts); he no longer stands in his study.
Exethanter was destroyed (encounter exethanter_wrath). With his phylactery intact he would re-form in time; Phase 6 may read it.
Exethanter has come down to the sanctum after the broker was dealt with and said his piece (vault:aftermath).
The party read the wardens' visitors' ledger (book prop): a courteous prince, and Exethanter's 'I showed him'. Unlocks Exethanter's memory of Strahd.
The party has met Master Vosk (in the library or the sanctum); he leaves the library for the vaults; quest the_amber_temple broker_met.
Insight showed the party that Vosk is no scholar (a jackal's shadow, glassless spectacles, or his lie about Aurel).
The party knows Vosk's true name, Ashkarreth (Exethanter's note, given once his phylactery is returned or kept, or found in his notes): it binds him in the sanctum, or weakens him in a fight.
A Deception trick fed Vosk's own shadow to the hollow amber; he fights weakened (encounter vosk_unmasked).

How the broker's story ended without a fight: banished (bound by his true name, gone from the valley) or paid (someone accepted gift_of_the_hollow and he left smiling). A fight sets vosk_destroyed instead. Phase 6 (Strahd's scenes) may read it.
Vosk the arcanaloth was destroyed in the sanctum (encounter vosk_unmasked); quest the_amber_temple broker_destroyed.
The honey-glow doors to the vault of offerings are open (the word, Arcana, force or blood).
The honey-glow doors were forced or bled open: the vault guardian wakes (encounter vault_guardian triggers on this flag).
The amber golem guarding the vault doors is destroyed (encounter vault_guardian).
The party read the wardens' copper record of Strahd's bargain: ledger (the terms) or full (with the Tome of Strahd beside it: why he made it). Phase 6: Strahd's scenes and the endings may read it.
Guard: the Amber Temple's one milestone has been given (vault:revelation, after the broker is dealt with).
The party answered Exethanter about the wardens' last rite (seal the temple or leave it open).
Exethanter sealed every sarcophagus: the vestiges are silent and no more gifts can be taken. Epilogue may read it.
The party met Patrina Velikovna's banshee in the hall of echoes; quest patrinas_wail heard.
The party knows the banshee is Patrina, Kasimir's sister (from Kasimir's story, or Kasimir is with them).

Patrina's end: rest (laid to rest by word, prayer or her brother) or restored (Kasimir's bargain with Tarakamedes: she walks out alive toward the castle). A fight sets patrina_destroyed instead. Phase 6 reads restored (she is at the castle) and rest (her bones under the castle are quiet).
Patrina's banshee was destroyed (encounter patrina_wails); quest patrinas_wail destroyed.
Kasimir's choice at Tarakamedes: made (every year he had left but one, for Patrina's life) or refused. Phase 6 / epilogue may read it (Kasimir has a year left).
Kasimir said to Patrina what he never had, and she let go. Banter; Phase 6 may read it.
The party found the frozen expedition on the ice stair (event, once).
